title: bzm-vitals-format Execution Outcome (format v1)
description: One Outcome per finished Execution. Mirrors validateOutcome in bzm-vitals-format, and is tested to agree with it. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere; the status vocabulary is closed.

lostNavigations.description: Optional (additive). Main-frame Navigations seen to commit with no Sample written.

path.description: Optional (additive). Spec path relative to testDir, POSIX separators.
